notes.title: 2v2 Update
notes.notes:
The 2v2 Update Is Here!

Twice the players, twice the fun? Go and try out the new 2v2 mode and experience even more shenanigans and great gameplay with your friends!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43998412/db48905600a1941cdffc552285f8954e720f471e.png

Added

- 2v2 gamemode
- a new safe in the mansion in the 2v2 mode, making the total safe number 4
- xmas decorations!
- ability to select location when creating a room, making it easier to find games on your area, which helps with finding lower latency games
- icons on the dog and the laser alarm when they are activated, making them more useful

Fixed

- a bug where the guard would fall inside the floor after stepping on the marbles
- a bug, that if the round ended while the guard was using the cameras, the ui would burn to the screen

notes.title: More Settings Update
notes.notes:
Hello Thieves and Guards!

Here is a small update for you guys!

Added

- More items setting, that allows you to set the max amount of buyable items to 5 (all items has this as a max amount, consider this as a party mode)
- Invert mouse axis X and Y setting
- 8 and 10 minutes round setting
- More adjustment to the brightness setting
- You can switch between items using numbers on your keyboard. (These are currently fixed, they will be added to the key bindings list later)

Fixed

- a bug where the marbles allowed the Guard to get over the fence
- multiple spots where the Thief was able to get over the fence
- a bug where the Guard was able to exit the mansion during buy time

notes.title: Server Browser And Room Settings Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Server browser and room settings update is here!

This update adds a server browser(beta), you can jump into rooms and start playing easily.

When creating a room, you have now several settings that you can modify, including round amount, round time and more. You can make a custom game to your likingːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Last Week We...Release Date Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello Everybody and Happy Monday!

Last week we released a new trailer! It showcases the game and shows the release date: March 28, 2024

Also we made a small update to the playtest!

-added a new route to the yard (removed too op one)
-you now get more money from losing and winning a round
-made changes to player sounds and how they can be heard through walls
-added ability to enter and exit with using the same button to cameras and lock picking
-improved the dog


Until next week!

notes.title: Beta Update 0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Thieves and Guards!

Beta update 0.2 is here! The update brings new items to the game as well as bug fixes and improvements!*

-New Item: Bear Trap
-New Item: Smoke Grenade
-New Item: Marbles
The items can be bought from the shop at the start of the round

-Fixed a bug where player movement gets stuck after round ends.
-Blocked Guards route over the fence on the front yard, Thief also can´t use this route anymore.
-Added plant sounds to the yard and inside the mansion.
-Fixed a bug where the game tries to start in VR mode.

*Settings had to be reset

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43998412/b09c6424b3bc6519624ab0aefe2d17c50bcf0c9d.png

notes.title: Last Week We...First Beta Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Last week we released the first update to the beta! Small update brings few fixes and quality of life improvements for new players!

-Support for higher resolutions added*
-Support for borderless and windowed added*
-Hatch to office now opens correctly
-Added invisible wall so that the Guard can't get over the fence
-Added "i" icons to indicate important/interactive items on the map
-Added shopping cart icon

*Settings had to be reset


See you next week!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43998412/120c5c9b660107e67eb31246f21a298f7d2472b8.png
